english.html: so as to be judged definitively, and the same having been reviewed, the Court, upon great and mature deliberation, pronounced the decision which follows.

SEEN the trial conducted by the Judge of Rieux against Arnauld du Tilh, called Pansette, calling himself Martin Guerre, prisoner in the Conciergerie, appellant from the said Judge, etc. It has been declared that the Court has set aside and sets aside the appeal of the said du Tilh, and the judgment appealed from, as null. And for the punishment and reparation of the imposture, forgery, substitution of name and person, adultery, rape, sacrilege, enslavement, theft and other offences committed by the said du Tilh, prisoner, resulting from the said trial, the Court has condemned and condemns him to make public penance (amende honorable) before the Church of the place of Artigat, and there, on his knees, in a shirt, bareheaded and barefoot, having the halter round his neck and holding in his hands a burning wax taper, to ask pardon of God, of the King, of Justice, and of the said Martin Guerre and de Rols, married persons: and this done, the said du Tilh shall be delivered into the hands of the executioner, who shall make him go the rounds through the accustomed streets and crossroads of the said place of Artigat: and, the halter round his neck, shall lead him before the house of the said Martin Guerre,

VEV le procés fait par le Iuge de Rieux
à Arnauld du Tilh, dit Panſette, ſoy di
ſant Martin Guerre, priſonnier à la
conciergerie, appelant dudit Iuge, & c. Dit a eſté
que la cour a mis, & met l'appellation dudit du
Tilh, & ce dont a eſté appelé, au neant. Et pour
punitiõ & reparatiõ de l'impoſture, fauſſeté, ſup
poſition de nom, & perſonne, adultere, rapt, ſa-
crilege, plage, larrecin, & autres cas par ledit du
Tilh priſonnier commis, reſultans dudit procez.
La cour l'a condemné, & condemne à faire a-
mende honnorable au deuant de l'Egliſe du lieu
d'Artigat, & illec à genoux, en chemiſe, teſte,
& pieds nuds, ayant la hart au col, & tenant
en ſes mains vne torche de cire ardente, deman-
der pardon à Dieu, au Roy, à Iuſtice, auſdits
Martin Guerre, & de Rols mariez: & ce fait,
ſera ledit du Tilh deliuré és mains de l'execu-
teur de la haute Iuſtice, qui luy fera faire les
tours par les rues, & carrefours accouſtumez
dudit lieu d'Artigat: & la hart au col, l'amene-
ra au deuant la maiſon dudit Martin Guerre,
